nodes.descriptionEn: 40nm CMOS Image Sensor process flow. From pixel array to microlens, learn CIS manufacturing and optoelectronic integration.
nodes.descriptionZh: 40nm CMOS 图像传感器完整工艺流程。从像素阵列到微透镜，系统学习 CIS 制造工艺与光电集成技术。

nodes.descriptionEn: Mature process node with full coverage from STI to Final Passivation. Ideal for learning semiconductor manufacturing fundamentals and HKMG integration.
nodes.descriptionZh: 成熟制程节点，完整覆盖从 STI 到 Final Passivation 的全部工艺流程。适合系统学习半导体制造基础概念与 HKMG 集成工艺。

nodes.descriptionEn: Advanced process node with 3D transistor architecture. Explore FinFET integration, multi-patterning, and advanced interconnect technologies.
nodes.descriptionZh: 先进制程节点，采用 3D 晶体管架构。深入了解 FinFET 工艺集成、多重图案化与先进互连技术。

nodes.descriptionEn: Cutting-edge process node with advanced FinFET architecture and multi-patterning. Explore self-aligned contacts, advanced interconnect, and packaging technologies.
nodes.descriptionZh: 前沿制程节点，采用先进 FinFET 架构与多重图案化技术。探索自对准接触、先进互连与封装技术。

concepts.definitionEn: Dielectric-filled trenches etched into the silicon substrate and planarized by CMP to electrically isolate adjacent active transistor regions without bird's-beak encroachment.
concepts.definitionZh: 在硅衬底刻蚀沟槽并填充绝缘介质后经化学机械平坦化，以在相邻有源晶体管区之间建立无鸟嘴侵蚀的电学隔离。

concepts.definitionEn: Replaces thermally grown SiO2 and polysilicon electrodes with high-permittivity hafnium-based dielectrics and work-function metal stacks to suppress quantum gate tunneling leakage and eliminate poly depletion.
concepts.definitionZh: 采用高介电常数铪基介质与功函数金属栅替代传统二氧化硅与多晶硅栅，大幅抑制纳米等效氧化层厚度下的直接隧穿漏电并消除多晶硅耗尽效应。

concepts.definitionEn: Wraps the gate electrode around three sides of a vertical silicon fin to restore electrostatic control, reduce drain-induced barrier lowering (DIBL), and achieve near-ideal subthreshold swing.
concepts.definitionZh: 让栅电极从三面包覆垂直硅鳍沟道，增强栅极静电控制力，显著抑制漏致势垒降低（DIBL）并逼近理想亚阈值摆幅。

concepts.definitionEn: Uses lattice-mismatched epitaxial semiconductors in recessed source/drain regions (such as compressive SiGe for pMOS) to modify band structure and boost carrier mobility.
concepts.definitionZh: 在源漏凹槽中选择性外延生长晶格失配半导体材料（如 pMOS 源漏硅锗压应力层），改变沟道能带结构并提升载流子迁移率。

concepts.definitionEn: Sidewall spacer pitch-multiplication techniques that divide 193nm immersion lithography feature pitch by 2x or 4x to define sub-wavelength fin and metal routing arrays.
concepts.definitionZh: 利用侧墙沉积与回蚀倍频技术，将 193nm 浸没式光刻图形节距缩减至 1/2（SADP）或 1/4（SAQP），实现亚波长鳍片与互连图形定义。

concepts.definitionEn: Protects recessed metal gates with a dielectric cap so middle-of-line source/drain contact etching can selectively land between tight gate pitches without shorting to the gate.
concepts.definitionZh: 利用栅极顶部的绝缘保护帽在刻蚀中道源漏接触孔时提供高选择比自对准保护，防止紧凑栅节距下套刻偏差导致栅-源漏短路。

concepts.definitionEn: Forms back-end-of-line metal routing by etching both vias and line trenches into low-k dielectric before barrier liner deposition, copper electroplating, and planarization.
concepts.definitionZh: 在低介电常数层间介质中预刻蚀通孔与导线沟槽，随后一体完成扩散阻挡层沉积、铜电镀填充与化学机械平坦化。

concepts.definitionEn: Chemical reactions and mechanical action remove excess copper, planarizing the interconnect surface while retaining the conductor in recessed features.
concepts.definitionZh: 通过表面化学反应与机械作用去除多余铜，使互连表面平坦，并保留凹槽中的导体。

concepts.definitionEn: A conductive copper seed layer provides the electrically connected surface needed for subsequent electrochemical copper filling.
concepts.definitionZh: 在后续铜填充前形成导电种子层，为电化学沉积提供连续的导电表面。

concepts.termEn: Copper Seed Layer Physical Vapor Deposition
concepts.definitionEn: Physical vapor deposition forms a copper seed surface for later electroplating; continuous coverage helps plating begin uniformly.
concepts.definitionZh: 通过物理气相沉积形成铜种子层，为后续电镀铜提供导电表面；覆盖连续性影响填充能否均匀开始。

concepts.definitionEn: Polishing removes excess tantalum-based barrier from field regions, exposing the dielectric surface between neighboring copper interconnects.
concepts.definitionZh: 去除场区多余的钽基阻挡层，使相邻铜互连之间的介质表面重新露出。

concepts.definitionEn: A tantalum-based liner separates copper from the surrounding dielectric, limiting copper diffusion and providing an interconnect interface.
concepts.definitionZh: 在铜与周围介质之间形成钽基阻挡衬层，限制铜扩散，并提供互连界面。

concepts.definitionEn: Cleaning after planarization removes residual polishing particles and chemical contamination that can affect later interfaces and electrical reliability.
concepts.definitionZh: 平坦化后去除表面残留的抛光颗粒与化学污染物，减少它们对后续界面和电学可靠性的影响。

concepts.definitionEn: Post-polish cleaning and surface passivation balance residue removal with protection of the exposed copper surface against corrosion.
concepts.definitionZh: 在去除抛光残留后调理暴露表面，兼顾污染物清除与铜表面的腐蚀保护。

concepts.definitionEn: Cleaning and surface conditioning before resist coating reduce contamination that can interfere with resist adhesion and pattern formation.
concepts.definitionZh: 在涂覆光刻胶前清除表面污染并调理界面，减少污染物对胶膜附着与图形形成的干扰。

concepts.termEn: Photoresist Ashing and Polymer Removal and Post-Etch Wet Strip and Cleaning
concepts.definitionEn: After etching, plasma ashing, wet stripping and cleaning remove photoresist and process residues before subsequent interface processing.
concepts.definitionZh: 刻蚀后结合等离子体灰化、湿法去胶与清洗，去除光刻胶及工序残留，为后续界面处理创造条件。

concepts.termEn: Photoresist Plasma Ashing and Post-Implant Wet Strip and Surface Cleaning
concepts.definitionEn: After ion implantation, plasma ashing and wet cleaning remove photoresist and residues before the wafer proceeds to subsequent processing.
concepts.definitionZh: 离子注入后通过等离子体灰化和湿法清洗去除光刻胶及残留，使晶圆进入后续工序。

concepts.termEn: Inter-Layer Dielectric Silicon Carbonitride Barrier Deposition
concepts.definitionEn: A silicon carbonitride dielectric barrier separates copper interconnects from subsequent dielectric layers and limits copper diffusion.
concepts.definitionZh: 沉积碳氮化硅介质阻挡层，将铜互连与后续介质隔开，并限制铜向介质扩散。

concepts.definitionEn: Silicon carbonitride deposition adds a dielectric film to the interconnect stack; its insulating or barrier role depends on the surrounding structure.
concepts.definitionZh: 沉积碳氮化硅介质膜，构成互连层间介质堆叠的一部分；具体隔离或阻挡作用取决于所在结构。

concepts.definitionEn: Deposited silicon dioxide electrically separates interconnect levels and provides the dielectric body for later via and trench patterns.
concepts.definitionZh: 沉积二氧化硅层间介质，使不同互连层电学隔离，并为后续通孔与沟槽图形提供介质主体。

concepts.definitionEn: Selective removal of silicon carbonitride extends an interconnect opening to the intended interface while controlling attack on neighboring materials.
concepts.definitionZh: 在选定区域去除碳氮化硅介质，使互连开口延伸到目标界面，同时需要控制对相邻材料的影响。

comparisons.titleZh: 40nm ↔ 28nm 半导体工艺代际演进对比
comparisons.taglineEn: From Planar Poly-Si Gate to High-k Metal Gate (HKMG) and Strain Engineering
comparisons.taglineZh: 从平面多晶硅栅到 High-k 金属栅（HKMG）与应变硅工程的物理飞跃
comparisons.summaryEn: 40nm marks the physical scaling limit of conventional Poly/SiON planar technology. As one of the longest-lived nodes in industry history, 28nm introduced High-k Metal Gate (HKMG), Replacement Metal Gate (RMG) flows, and embedded SiGe channel strain engineering, slashing gate leakage by over 100x.
comparisons.summaryZh: 40nm 标志着传统多晶硅栅氧（Poly/SiON）工艺的物理缩减极限，而 28nm 作为半导体历史上最具生命力的长寿节点，全面引入了高介电常数金属栅（HKMG）、先栅/后栅替换金属工艺（RMG）与嵌入式 SiGe 沟道应变工程，将栅极漏电流降低 100 倍以上。

metrics.significanceEn: Maintains planar topology while overhauling gate materials
metrics.significanceZh: 延续平面拓扑，全面重构栅介质与电极材料

metrics.sourceValueZh: SiO2 / SiON (接近物理减薄极限)
metrics.targetValueZh: ALD HfO2 (高 κ 介质，显著更低 EOT)
metrics.significanceEn: 5x higher dielectric constant suppresses direct tunneling
metrics.significanceZh: 介电常数提升 5 倍以上，有效抑制量子直接隧穿

metrics.significanceEn: Eliminates poly depletion and its Tinv capacitance penalty
metrics.significanceZh: 消除多晶硅反型层耗尽，显著压低反型层等效电学厚度 (Tinv)

metrics.significanceEn: Standard cell area shrinks by ~50% compared to 40nm
metrics.significanceZh: 逻辑标准单元面积相比 40nm 缩小约 50%

metrics.significanceEn: Quadratic dynamic power scaling delivers >30% energy efficiency
metrics.significanceZh: 动态功耗成平方级下降，能效提升超 30%

metrics.targetValueZh: pMOS 嵌入式 eSiGe 单轴压应变
metrics.significanceEn: 30-50% hole mobility boost balances PMOS/NMOS drive ratio
metrics.significanceZh: 空穴迁移率提高 30%–50%，大幅均衡 PMOS/NMOS 驱动比

highlights.sourceFeatureZh: SiO2/SiON 介质 + 掺杂多晶硅栅
highlights.targetFeatureZh: ALD HfO2 高介电层 + 替换金属栅 (RMG)
highlights.significanceEn: Markedly reduces EOT without thinning the physical barrier, eliminates poly depletion effect, and cuts quantum tunneling gate leakage by >100x.
highlights.significanceZh: 显著压减等效氧化层厚度 (EOT) 同时保持物理势垒宽度，彻底消除多晶硅栅耗尽效应，栅极量子隧穿漏电降低两个数量级。

highlights.sourceFeatureZh: 传统平面离子注入与热退火
highlights.targetFeatureZh: pMOS 嵌入式硅锗 (eSiGe) + nMOS 应力记忆 (SMT)
highlights.significanceEn: Induces uniaxial compressive channel strain via lattice mismatch, boosting hole mobility by 30-50% and saturation drive current.
highlights.significanceZh: 利用晶格失配在沟道诱导单轴纵向压应变，使空穴迁移率提升 30%–50%，驱动电流显著增强。

highlights.sourceFeatureZh: 深沟槽隔离 (DTI) 阻断串扰 + 常规 STI
highlights.targetFeatureEn: High Aspect Ratio HARP oxide + high-selectivity STI CMP
highlights.targetFeatureZh: 高深宽比 HARP 氧化物填充 + 高选择性 STI CMP
highlights.significanceEn: Delivers void-free trench fill with pad nitride pullback and minimal CMP dishing for sub-120nm pitch.
highlights.significanceZh: 实现致密无微空洞氧化物填充，搭配垫氮化硅回缩与低浅碟平坦化工艺。

highlights.targetFeatureEn: Ultra Low-k (ULK, k<2.5) with UV cure
highlights.targetFeatureZh: 超低介电常数介质 (ULK, k<2.5) + 紫外光固化
highlights.significanceEn: Substantially suppresses parasitic RC interconnect capacitance and high-frequency propagation delay.
highlights.significanceZh: 大幅降低高频金属布线间的寄生 RC 容抗与信号互连延迟。

comparisons.titleZh: 28nm ↔ 14nm 半导体工艺代际演进对比
comparisons.taglineEn: The Historic Leap from 2D Planar MOSFETs to 3D FinFET and Self-Aligned Double Patterning (SADP)
comparisons.taglineZh: 从二维平面晶体管向三维立构 FinFET 与自对准双重曝光（SADP）的历史跨越
comparisons.summaryEn: The 28nm-to-14nm transition represents the most profound transistor architecture revolution in 40 years: as 2D planar channels reached 20nm gate lengths, short-channel effects and DIBL caused catastrophic leakage. 14nm tri-gate FinFETs wrap the gate on three sides of a vertical silicon fin, restoring near-ideal electrostatics while introducing SADP pitch halving and Self-Aligned Contacts (SAC).
comparisons.summaryZh: 从 28nm 到 14nm 是近四十年来晶体管物理架构最根本的转折点：二维平面沟道在栅长逼近 20nm 时遭遇毁灭性的短沟道效应与漏极诱导势垒降低（DIBL），14nm 通过构建垂直 3D 硅鳍片（FinFET），栅极三面紧密包裹，重建了近乎理想的静电控制；同时光刻突破瑞利衍射极限，首次引入自对准双重曝光（SADP）与自对准接触（SAC）。

metrics.significanceZh: 三维静电全包围控制，彻底根除漏极穿通效应

metrics.targetValueZh: 自对准双重曝光 (SADP, 鳍节距 ~48nm)
metrics.significanceEn: Pitch halving bypasses immersion optical diffraction limits
metrics.significanceZh: 节距减半技术打破光学分辨率极限

metrics.significanceEn: >32% tighter gate pitch slashes overall chip area by ~50%
metrics.significanceZh: 栅极接触节距紧缩超 32%，芯片面积缩减近 50%

metrics.significanceEn: Sharper turn-off characteristics reduce OFF-state leakage >10x
metrics.significanceZh: 关断特性极陡，关态漏电流减小 10 倍以上

metrics.significanceEn: Voltage reduction cuts dynamic switching energy by >50%
metrics.significanceZh: 电压大幅降低使同性能功耗节省超过 50%

metrics.sourceValueZh: 受严格光刻套刻对准限制
metrics.targetValueZh: 自对准接触 (SAC) 绝缘帽保护
metrics.significanceEn: Allows contact overlap without risk of catastrophic gate shorts
metrics.significanceZh: 允许接触孔物理重叠栅极，无需额外开孔间隙

highlights.significanceEn: Three-sided gate wrap suppresses DIBL, steepening subthreshold swing from ~90 to ~68 mV/dec.
highlights.significanceZh: 栅极三面包围超薄垂直鳍片，亚阈值摆幅从 ~90 优化至 ~68 mV/dec，彻底压制短沟道漏电。

highlights.targetFeatureZh: 自对准双重曝光 (SADP 节距减半)
highlights.significanceEn: Mandrel spacer deposition and pull doubles pattern density, overcoming optical Rayleigh limits to hit sub-48nm fin pitch.
highlights.significanceZh: 通过牺牲芯模侧墙保形沉积与抽取，打破单次光学曝光极限，将鳍节距压缩至 48nm 以下。

highlights.targetFeatureZh: 自对准接触 (SAC) + 栅顶氮化硅保护帽
highlights.significanceEn: Nitride gate hardmask cap prevents source/drain contacts from shorting to the gate during overlay misalignment.
highlights.significanceZh: 利用接触孔蚀刻阻挡层 (CESL) 与栅极绝缘顶帽实现自对准刻蚀，消除接触孔与栅极短路风险。

highlights.sourceFeatureZh: 高深宽比 HARP CVD 氧化物
highlights.targetFeatureZh: 流动性化学气相沉积 (FCVD) + 鳍片回蚀
highlights.significanceEn: Liquid-like precursor fills deep sub-15nm fin trenches void-free; precision recess etch reveals targeted 3D fin height.
highlights.significanceZh: 以类液体流动方式完全无微缝填满 15nm 以下超高深宽比鳍间间隙，经精确回蚀暴露鳍高。

comparisons.titleZh: 14nm ↔ 7nm 半导体工艺代际演进对比
comparisons.taglineEn: From SADP to SAQP Quadruple Patterning, Single Diffusion Break (SDB), and Cobalt Interconnect
comparisons.taglineZh: 从自对准双重曝光到四重曝光（SAQP）、单扩散阻断（SDB）与钴互连革命
comparisons.summaryEn: 7nm represents the ultimate zenith of deep-ultraviolet (DUV) multi-patterning, nearly tripling transistor density compared to 14nm (>90 MTr/mm²). To resolve sub-27nm fin pitch, the process advances from SADP to SAQP quadruple patterning. Standard cells introduce Single Diffusion Break (SDB) scaling from 9T to 6T libraries. In BEOL metallization, severe Cu resistivity explosion and electromigration are conquered via M0 local routing and CVD pure Cobalt (Co) barrier/capping layers.
comparisons.summaryZh: 7nm 是深紫外（DUV）多重曝光技术的物理巅峰，晶体管密度相比 14nm 暴增近 3 倍（突破 90 MTr/mm²）。为了在浸润式光刻下刻出 ~27nm 极窄鳍节距，工艺演进至自对准四重曝光（SAQP）；标准单元全面攻克单扩散阻断（SDB），将单元高度由 9T 压缩至 6T；而在互连层，面对铜金属在 15nm 线宽下的电阻率暴增与电迁移失效，全面引入 M0 局部互连与 CVD 纯钴（Cobalt）金属化。

metrics.significanceEn: Nearly double fin count expands effective total channel width
metrics.significanceZh: 鳍片密度提高近一倍，单位硅面积有效沟道宽度大增

metrics.significanceEn: Ultra-scaled gate spacing strains parasitic capacitance margins
metrics.significanceZh: 器件栅间距压缩至极限，寄生电容与接触电阻控制要求极苛刻

metrics.significanceEn: 33% lower cell height drives density beyond 90 MTr/mm²
metrics.significanceZh: 单元高度压缩 33%，推动晶体管集成度突破 90 MTr/mm²

metrics.sourceValueZh: 双扩散阻断 (DDB, 占用 2 个栅极)
metrics.targetValueZh: 单扩散阻断 (SDB, 占用 1 个栅极)
metrics.significanceEn: Eliminates dummy gate overhead between adjacent logic cells
metrics.significanceZh: 单元边界间距减半，消除哑栅浪费

metrics.targetValueEn: M0 Local Interconnect + CVD Pure Cobalt (Co)
metrics.targetValueZh: M0 局部互连 + CVD 纯钴 (Co) 保护层
metrics.significanceEn: >100x electromigration lifetime enhancement for sub-20nm lines
metrics.significanceZh: 亚 20nm 导线抗电迁移寿命提升 100 倍以上

metrics.significanceEn: ~3x density surge underpins modern flagship AI accelerators
metrics.significanceZh: 晶体管密度提升近 3 倍，奠定现代先进 AI 芯片物理基石

highlights.sourceFeatureZh: 自对准双重曝光 (SADP, 2x 节距减半)
highlights.targetFeatureZh: 自对准四重曝光 (SAQP, 4x 节距四倍增)
highlights.significanceEn: Two sequential mandrel-spacer cycles split one litho line into 4 fins, achieving sub-27nm fin pitch with DUV.
highlights.significanceZh: 经历两次芯轴与两级侧墙成型，单条光刻线倍增为 4 条纳米鳍线，突破 27nm 以下极限。

highlights.significanceEn: Isolates cell boundaries within a single gate pitch instead of two, reducing library footprint by >15%.
highlights.significanceZh: 在仅消耗 1 个栅极空间的狭窄区域切断有源区并回填绝缘材料，使逻辑库面积紧凑化 >15%。

highlights.sourceFeatureZh: 纯铜双大马士革互连 + Ta/TaN 阻挡层
highlights.targetFeatureEn: M0 Local Interconnect + CVD Pure Cobalt (Co)
highlights.targetFeatureZh: M0 局部互连 + CVD 纯钴 (Co) 覆盖/衬层
highlights.significanceEn: Cobalt has shorter electron mean free path in sub-20nm trenches; electromigration resistance jumps by >100x.
highlights.significanceZh: 钴在亚 20nm 线宽下电子自由程短且无晶界散射恶化，抗电迁移寿命比铜提高两个数量级。

highlights.targetFeatureZh: 3–4 次独立曝光硬掩膜记忆刻蚀 (LELELE)
highlights.significanceEn: Splits ultra-dense contact matrices into multiple relaxed exposures, stored sequentially in memorization layers.
highlights.significanceZh: 将密集端子图形拆分为多组稀疏曝光，通过 SiON 与碳基记忆层逐次保留并统一转移。

articles.primaryKeyword: 7nm FinFET starting wafer and substrate preparation process flow
articles.titleEn: 7nm FinFET Starting Wafer and Substrate Preparation: Integration Principles, Device Physics, and Process Flow
articles.titleZh: 7nm FinFET 起始晶圆与衬底制备：集成原理、器件物理与工艺流
articles.excerptEn: The starting wafer and substrate preparation (WFR) module is the foundational entry point of the entire 7nm FinFET process flow.
articles.excerptZh: 晶圆起始与衬底制备（WFR）模块是整个 7nm FinFET 工艺流的基础入口点。在进行任何鳍片图形化、栅极堆叠形成或源/漏外延之前，晶圆必须经过选择、清洗，并具备精确的晶向、掺杂剂类型和表面状态。

articles.titleEn: ALD vs CVD: Saturation, Coverage and Fill
articles.titleZh: ALD与CVD：分清饱和、覆盖与填充证据
articles.excerptEn: Atomic layer deposition (ALD) separates complementary surface reactions and seeks saturation in each reaction step.
articles.excerptZh: 原子层沉积（ALD）分离互补的表面反应，并力求使每个反应步骤达到饱和。常规化学气相沉积（CVD）在反应物供应期间生长薄膜，生长受反应与传输共同影响。仅有脉冲不能证明ALD，ALD名称也不能证明完整覆盖或无空洞填充。应分别比较供料顺序、自限性的证据与实际薄膜结果。 ALD属于更广义的化学气相沉积家族。

articles.titleEn: Average Dark Current and the Hot-Pixel Tail Need Separate Evidence
articles.titleZh: 平均暗电流与热像素尾部需要分别取证
articles.excerptEn: A lower array-average dark current does not by itself prove that rare high-dark-current pixels improved.
articles.excerptZh: 阵列平均暗电流降低，本身不证明少数高暗电流像素改善。平均值概括总体，尾部描述其中很小的一部分；两者都影响图像，却可以朝不同方向变化。 局部缺陷和工艺差异会使像素之间存在很大区别。多数像素暗信号很小时，少数像素仍可能形成可见白点。钉扎光电二极管综述同时讨论低平均暗电流与局部问题。

articles.titleEn: Barrier vs Liner: Different Jobs at a Metal Interface
articles.titleZh: 金属阻挡层与衬垫：同一界面里的不同任务
articles.excerptEn: Compare diffusion barriers, liners and seed roles without treating interface functions as interchangeable material names.
articles.excerptZh: 比较扩散阻挡、衬垫与种子层角色，避免把界面功能当成可互换的材料名称。

articles.titleEn: CET and Dielectric EOT: What Does the Capacitance Include?
articles.titleZh: CET 与介质 EOT：电容究竟包括什么？
articles.excerptEn: An electrical thickness inferred from a measured MOS capacitance need not equal the equivalent thickness assigned to its dielectric layers.
articles.excerptZh: 由实测 MOS 电容推得的电学厚度，不一定等于只给介质各层计算的等效厚度。半导体中的电荷响应也可能参与实测电容。比较 CET 与 EOT 之前，应先说明作者把哪些电容算进去了：不同来源的术语和提取约定未必一致。

articles.titleEn: Why Charge Transfer Can Change from Drift to Diffusion
articles.titleZh: 为什么电荷转移会从漂移转向扩散
articles.excerptEn: A rapid initial charge transfer does not prove that the last carriers leave just as rapidly.
articles.excerptZh: 初始电荷转移很快，不证明最后一批载流子也同样快地离开。漂移响应电场，扩散响应载流子浓度梯度；转移过程中电势与载流子数量会演变，使限制剩余信号的贡献改变。 PPD 综述讨论大初始信号下的自致漂移。载流子离开储荷阱后，分布与局部驱动条件改变，因此不能把初始转移速率不加变化地外推到几乎空的阱。

articles.titleEn: Chemical Junction and Depletion Boundary Are Different Locations
articles.titleZh: 化学结与耗尽区边界是不同位置
articles.excerptEn: A chemical junction is defined by the dopant profile where the relevant concentrations balance.
articles.excerptZh: 化学结由相关掺杂浓度相平衡处的分布定义；耗尽区边界则界定所关注电学状态下移动载流子减少的区域。两者不是同一几何线的两个名称。 对于简单扩散区，教材把引入化学浓度与背景浓度相交处定义为冶金结。这是浓度分布定义；电学载流子分布可与化学边界不同，实际补偿或复杂分布还需要更谨慎解释。 光刻开口并不直接测量浓度分布。

articles.titleEn: Chip Interconnect Levels: BEOL, RDL, TSV and Packaging
articles.titleZh: 芯片互连层级：BEOL、RDL、TSV与封装如何区分
articles.excerptEn: Trace the physical boundaries from on-chip wiring to die-to-die and board connections, with a diagram and a signal-path exercise.
articles.excerptZh: 用层级图和信号路径练习，区分片上布线、晶粒间连接及对板连接，避免把TSV、RDL和键合混为一谈。

articles.titleEn: CMP Dishing vs Erosion: Read the Reference Surface
articles.titleZh: CMP 凹陷与侵蚀：先确定你比较的参考面
articles.excerptEn: Distinguish CMP dishing from erosion by comparing local metal, neighboring dielectric and the surrounding reference field.
articles.excerptZh: 用金属、相邻介质和外围场区三个参考面，区分CMP局部凹陷与区域侵蚀。

articles.titleEn: CMP vs Etch Endpoint: What Does the Signal Mean?
articles.titleZh: CMP 与刻蚀终点：信号究竟说明了什么？
articles.excerptEn: Understand what CMP and etch endpoint signals indicate, and why a transition does not verify every local structure.
articles.excerptZh: 解释CMP与刻蚀终点信号的含义，以及为什么检测到转变不等于所有结构合格。

articles.primaryKeyword: Color filters, clear layers and microlenses: three different jobs in a BSI pixel
articles.titleEn: Color filters, clear layers and microlenses: three different jobs in a BSI pixel
articles.titleZh: 彩色滤光片、透明平坦层与微透镜：BSI 像素里三种不同的工作
articles.excerptEn: Color filters select the light reaching a pixel, a clear base prepares the surface above the filter array, and a microlens redirects light toward the sensing region. Reading these structures as three interchangeable “sensitivity layers” misses why the process needs all three.
articles.excerptZh: 彩色滤光片选择到达像素的光谱，透明基底层为滤光阵列上方准备表面，微透镜则把光引向感光区域。若把三者都理解成可以互相替代的“增感层”，就无法解释为什么流程需要依次完成这些不同工作。

articles.titleEn: Contact vs Interconnect Resistance: Follow the Current
articles.titleZh: 接触电阻与互连电阻：沿电流路径区分贡献
articles.excerptEn: Separate contact interfaces, access regions and metal lines to understand the resistance of a complete current path.
articles.excerptZh: 沿完整电流路径，区分接触界面、接入区域和金属线的电阻贡献。

articles.titleEn: Gate Pitch, Gate Length and Channel Length: Read the Boundaries
articles.titleZh: 栅距、物理栅长与有效沟道长度：先看边界
articles.excerptEn: Gate pitch, physical gate length and effective channel length describe different distances.
articles.excerptZh: 栅距、物理栅长和有效沟道长度描述的是不同距离。栅距说明相邻栅如何重复排列，物理栅长说明电极沿电流方向的图形长度，有效沟道长度则属于电学器件模型。没有统一定义和证据，不能用其中一个数替代另一个。 设想一排平行、等宽的栅线。沿垂直于栅线的方向，一个重复单元包含一条线以及到下一条线之间的空隙，重复距离就是节距。

articles.titleEn: Copper Dual Damascene: From Trenches and Vias to Fill and CMP
articles.titleZh: 铜双大马士革：沟槽、通孔、填充与 CMP 的交接
articles.excerptEn: Copper dual damascene forms a horizontal trench and a connecting via in dielectric, then includes both in one metallization and CMP cycle. “Dual” describes the organization of a line and a via. It does not mean simply etching twice or growing two metal levels at once.
articles.excerptZh: 铜双镶嵌先在介质中形成水平沟槽与向下连接的通孔，再把两者纳入同一轮金属填充和 CMP。这里的“双”指线与孔共同组织在一个金属化周期中，不是刻蚀两次，也不是两层金属同时长出来。

articles.titleEn: Dark Current vs Read Noise: Separate Charge and Readout
articles.titleZh: 暗电流与读出噪声：分开看电荷积累和读出
articles.excerptEn: Separate mean dark signal, dark-current shot noise and read noise when interpreting CMOS sensor behavior.
articles.excerptZh: 解释CMOS图像传感器时，分开平均暗信号、暗电流散粒噪声与读出噪声。

articles.titleEn: Die Yield, Defect Density and Critical Area: Read the Model
articles.titleZh: 晶粒良率、缺陷密度与关键面积：如何读懂模型
articles.excerptEn: Use a dimensionless Poisson example to distinguish defect counts, critical area and die yield, and identify when the assumptions fail.
articles.excerptZh: 通过无量纲泊松例子，分清缺陷计数、关键面积与晶粒良率，识别随机独立假设何时不成立。

articles.titleEn: Dielectric vs Metal-Fill Voids: Follow the Function
articles.titleZh: 介质空洞与金属空洞：先看缺陷打断了什么任务
articles.excerptEn: Compare dielectric and metal-fill voids by following isolation, conduction and later process accessibility.
articles.excerptZh: 沿隔离、导电和后续可达性，比较介质与金属填充空洞的不同后果。

articles.titleEn: Why a Thicker Dielectric Is Not the Same as Conductor Screening
articles.titleZh: 为什么更厚介质不等于导体屏蔽
articles.excerptEn: Increasing dielectric thickness changes electrostatic coupling and voltage drop.
articles.excerptZh: 介质增厚会改变静电耦合与电压降，却不会把绝缘层变成能够重新分布移动电荷、屏蔽电场的导体。半导体表面的结果取决于电荷分布和电学边界。 简单电容模型中，电容取决于几何和介电常数。电荷固定时，电容变化会改变压降；外加电压固定时，电容变化则改变相关电荷。这是两种比较，因此没有边界条件就不能解释厚度趋势。

articles.titleEn: A Diffusion Barrier Is Not Automatically an Electrical Insulator
articles.titleZh: 扩散屏障不自动等于电绝缘层
articles.excerptEn: A diffusion barrier limits the transport of a specified atomic species. An electrical insulator limits unwanted charge conduction under specified…
articles.excerptZh: 扩散屏障限制某种指定原子的输运；电绝缘层限制指定电学条件下不需要的电荷导通。一层膜可以承担两种职责，但其中一种职责不能认证另一种。必须说清被输运的对象和失效判据。 在铜边界处，屏障问题是铜能否穿过薄膜、缺陷或界面进入邻接材料；电学问题则是堆叠是否提供所需导电路径或隔离。两者的驱动力与证据不同。

articles.titleEn: Diffusion Break vs Dopant Diffusion: A Structure and an Atomic Process
articles.titleZh: 扩散隔断与掺杂扩散：结构与原子过程
articles.excerptEn: A diffusion break is a structural interruption used to separate device regions. Dopant diffusion is the movement and redistribution of impurity atoms.
articles.excerptZh: 扩散隔断是用于分开器件区域的结构性中断；掺杂扩散则是杂质原子的移动与重新分布。名称中都有“扩散”，不代表隔断是一种热处理，也不证明掺杂原子在后续加热时停止移动。 所引专利以鳍中的凹槽及介质填充建立扩散隔断，描述的是几何形状与材料边界。

articles.titleEn: Activation vs Diffusion: What Changes During Annealing?
articles.titleZh: 激活与扩散：退火过程中改变的是状态还是位置？
articles.excerptEn: Follow dopant state and position separately to understand activation, diffusion and damage recovery during annealing.
articles.excerptZh: 分别追踪掺杂状态与位置，理解退火中的激活、扩散和损伤恢复。

articles.titleZh: 双栅氧化层工程：先进CMOS制造中的物理原理、集成挑战与节点演进
articles.excerptEn: In modern microelectronics, the scaling of complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor (CMOS) technology has driven unprecedented integration density and processing performance.
articles.excerptZh: 在现代微电子技术中，互补金属氧化物半导体（CMOS）技术的持续微缩推动了前所未有的集成密度与处理性能。然而，器件尺寸的微缩在单个系统级芯片（SoC）内部引发了截然不同的工作电压需求。

articles.titleEn: Etching vs Cleaning: Removal Goals and Selectivity
articles.titleZh: 蚀刻与清洗：去除目的与选择性
articles.excerptEn: Etching and cleaning differ primarily in the intended removal task. Etching deliberately removes a specified material to obtain an opening, recess…
articles.excerptZh: 蚀刻与清洗主要按预期的去除任务区分。蚀刻有意去除指定材料，以获得开口、凹陷、暴露表面或其他结构结果；清洗去除不需要的颗粒、残留物或污染物，为下一步准备表面。两者的化学机制可以重叠：清洗可能伴随部分材料蚀刻，整面蚀刻也不一定用于图形转移。真正有用的判断是：什么必须去掉、什么必须留下、什么证据能说明任务完成。

articles.primaryKeyword: Why conformal coverage is not complete gap fill: liner versus FCVD
articles.titleEn: Why conformal coverage is not complete gap fill: liner versus FCVD
articles.titleZh: 共形覆盖为什么不等于填满沟槽？从衬垫到 FCVD 看区别
articles.excerptEn: Conformal deposition describes coverage along an existing surface. Gap fill asks whether material occupies the interior volume. Films can grow uniformly on both walls yet meet at the entrance before the interior is filled. FCVD uses a mobile depositing network to improve filling, while introducing its own conversion and material-stability requirements. A conformal liner remains useful because it has a different job in the same trench.
articles.excerptZh: 共形沉积强调薄膜沿已有表面连续覆盖；填沟强调空隙内部能否被材料占据。两侧壁上的膜即使一样均匀，继续增厚也可能先在入口会合，把内部尚未填满的空间封住。FCVD 利用沉积中间体的迁移能力改善填充，但仍需要后续转化与材料稳定性控制。它并不让共形衬垫失去价值：两者在同一沟槽里承担不同工作。

articles.titleEn: Field Oxide vs Gate Oxide: Isolation and Gate Control

articles.excerptEn: Field oxide and gate oxide describe different electrical roles. In a conventional silicon MOS example, the gate oxide separates a gate electrode from the…
articles.excerptZh: 场氧与栅氧描述的是不同的电学职责。在传统硅 MOS 示例中，栅氧把栅电极与预期沟道隔开，同时允许电容耦合来控制沟道；场氧用于有源器件区域之间的隔离，帮助抑制那里不需要的导电。两者都可以是二氧化硅；认出材料，并不等于认出其职责。 问题 栅氧 场氧 --- --- --- 相关区域在哪里？

articles.excerptEn: The FinFET fin is the defining structural element of the non-planar transistor architecture that has powered semiconductor scaling from the 22 nm node onward.

articles.primaryKeyword: Hardmask versus etch-stop layer: pattern placement and depth control
articles.titleEn: Hardmask versus etch-stop layer: pattern placement and depth control
articles.titleZh: 硬掩膜与刻蚀停止层：一个管开口，一个管边界
articles.excerptEn: A hardmask retains a pattern so that material is removed through selected openings. articles.titleZh: 半导体制造中的刻蚀停止层：原理、物理机制与集成逻辑

articles.excerptZh: 刻蚀停止层（ESL）是在半导体器件堆叠中沉积的一层薄薄的、对刻蚀具有选择性耐受力的薄膜，其作用是在精确界定的材料界面处终止刻蚀过程。

articles.titleEn: Etch Back Principles, Integration Physics, and Technology Node Evolution
articles.titleZh: 刻蚀回退原理、集成物理与技术节点演进
articles.excerptEn: In the continuous scaling of integrated circuits, achieving planar, void-free, and highly reliable multi-layer structures is a primary objective of process integration.
articles.excerptZh: 在集成电路的持续微缩过程中，实现平坦、无孔洞且高度可靠的多层结构是工艺集成的核心目标。在各种材料去除技术中，被称为刻蚀回退（Etch Back）的工艺发挥着至关重要作用。

articles.titleEn: Etch Rate: Removal, Selectivity, and Uniformity
articles.titleZh: 刻蚀速率：去除量、选择比与均匀性
articles.excerptEn: Etch rate measures removal of a specified material over time. Learn why selectivity, location and feature shape change how the number should be read, then locate two STI etches in a public Flow.
articles.excerptZh: 刻蚀速率测量特定材料在一段时间内的去除量。理解选择比、测量位置与图形形状为何影响解读，再到公开流程中定位两处STI刻蚀。

articles.titleEn: The Physics and Process Integration of Etch Stop Layers in Advanced Semiconductor Manufacturing
articles.titleZh: 先进半导体制造中刻蚀停止层（ESL）的物理机制与工艺集成
articles.excerptEn: In modern semiconductor manufacturing, maintaining atomic-scale dimensional control across high-aspect-ratio features is one of the most critical requirements for device scaling.
articles.excerptZh: 在现代半导体制造中，在深宽比特征结构中保持原子级尺寸控制是器件微缩最关键的要求之一。随着水平尺寸的缩小，干法刻蚀过程中的垂直深度控制极易受到工艺波动、衬底不均匀性和等离子体波动的影响。

articles.titleEn: Semiconductor Etching: Physical Principles, Process Mechanisms, and Advanced Integration
articles.titleZh: 半导体刻蚀：物理原理、工艺机制与先进集成
articles.excerptEn: Etching is a fundamental technique used to remove undesired material parts by physical or chemical methods to create precise microscopic structures.
articles.excerptZh: 简介 刻蚀是一种通过物理或化学方法去除不需要的材料部分，以构建精确微观结构的基础工艺。虽然最早的刻蚀技术出现在雕塑和印刷等领域，但现代刻蚀已演变为半导体制造中最关键的工艺之一。

articles.titleEn: Extreme Ultraviolet Lithography: Principles, Physics, and the Path to Sub-5nm Semiconductor Manufacturing
articles.titleZh: 极紫外光刻：原理、物理学与亚5nm半导体制造之路
articles.excerptEn: What Is Extreme Ultraviolet Lithography and Why Does It Matter? In the relentless pursuit of smaller, faster, and more energy-efficient semiconductor devices, lithography has…
articles.excerptZh: 介绍：什么是极紫外光刻及其为何重要？ 在追求更小、更快、更能效的半导体器件的不懈努力中，光刻一直是进步的节拍器。

articles.titleEn: Fundamental Principles of Fin Cut Trench (FCT) Technology in Advanced FinFET Integration
articles.titleZh: 先进 FinFET 集成中 Fin Cut Trench (FCT) 技术的基本原理
articles.excerptEn: In the continuous pursuit of Moore's law, the semiconductor industry transitioned from planar metal-oxide-semiconductor field-effect transistors (MOSFETs) to three-dimensional…
articles.excerptZh: 在不断追求摩尔定律的过程中，半导体行业从平面金属氧化物半导体场效应晶体管（MOSFET）过渡到三维（3D）架构，以克服严重的短沟道效应。

articles.titleEn: Fin Field Effect Transistor (FinFET): Physics, Process Principles, and Technology Evolution
articles.titleZh: 鳍式场效应晶体管（FinFET）：物理学、工艺原理和技术演进
articles.excerptEn: The fin field effect transistor (FinFET) is a three-dimensional metal-oxide-semiconductor field-effect transistor architecture in which the conducting channel is formed on a…
articles.excerptZh: 鳍式场效应晶体管（FinFET）是一种三维金属-氧化物-半导体场效应晶体管架构，其中导电沟道形成在从衬底表面突出的薄垂直硅鳍上，允许栅极电极绕过沟道的多个侧面。在场效应晶体管中，导电沟道由电场以电容方式进行控制 T2。

articles.titleEn: Fin Height Adjustment in Semiconductor Manufacturing: Physical Principles, Process Mechanisms, and Advanced Node Integration
articles.titleZh: 半导体制造中的鳍高调整：物理原理、工艺机制及先进节点集成
articles.excerptEn: Fin height adjustment is a critical semiconductor process step that controls the vertical dimension of silicon fins in Fin Field-Effect Transistor (FinFET) devices.
articles.excerptZh: 鳍高调整是半导体工艺中的关键步骤，它决定了鳍式场效应晶体管（FinFET）器件中硅鳍的垂直尺寸。在初始鳍图形化之后，必须精确设定鳍高，以实现所需的器件性能特性，包括驱动电流、静电控制和漏电抑制。

articles.titleEn: First Via Level (V1): Linking Wiring Layers
articles.titleZh: 第一层通孔（V1）：连接相邻布线层
articles.excerptEn: The first via connects adjacent metal levels through dielectric. The 40nm flow verifies Via 1 patterning and etches, but the selected trail does not verify a specific fill metal.
articles.excerptZh: 第一层通孔穿过介质连接相邻金属层。40nm 流程核实 Via 1 图形和刻蚀，选定路线未核实特定填充金属。

articles.titleEn: Demystifying Floating Diffusion in CMOS Image Sensors: Physics, Process Integration, and Scaling Challenges
articles.titleZh: 揭秘 CMOS 图像传感器中的浮动扩散区：物理机制、工艺集成与微缩挑战
articles.excerptEn: Floating diffusion is a pixel sensing node: transferred charge changes its voltage according to effective capacitance. The 40nm flow locates a related implant, not a measured sensor outcome.
articles.excerptZh: 浮动扩散区是像素感测节点，转移电荷通过有效电容改变节点电压。40nm 流程可定位相关注入，不能代替器件性能测量。

articles.titleEn: Flowable CVD: Gap Filling, Material Conversion and Planarization
articles.titleZh: 流动化学气相沉积（FCVD）：填沟、转化与平坦化
articles.excerptEn: Flowable chemical vapor deposition (FCVD) allows a depositing silicon-containing network to redistribute into narrow gaps, reducing the risk that the entrance closes before the interior is filled. Filling establishes where the material goes. Conversion and densification establish its material condition. CMP removes excess material and establishes a plane. A filled outline alone cannot demonstrate all three outcomes.
articles.excerptZh: 可流动化学气相沉积（FCVD）让沉积中的含硅网络具有迁移和填沟能力，以降低狭窄开口过早封口的风险。它解决的是材料怎样进入空隙；后续转化与致密化解决材料是否稳定，CMP 则去除顶部过量材料并建立平面。这三件事不能用“填满了”一并概括。

articles.titleEn: Forming Gas Anneal: Hydrogen Passivation Limits
articles.titleZh: 成形气退火：氢钝化机制、可达性与限制
articles.excerptEn: Forming gas anneal can passivate interface defects when hydrogen reaches them; gas safety and device benefit depend on the mixture and stack.
articles.excerptZh: 成形气退火可在氢到达界面时钝化部分缺陷；气体安全性与器件收益均取决于混合气和膜栈。

articles.titleEn: FEOL: What the Front End of Line Builds
articles.titleZh: 前段工艺（FEOL）：晶体管在硅里建成的全过程
articles.excerptEn: The front end of line (FEOL) builds the transistors themselves — isolation, gate stack, junctions, source/drain — everything before the first metal layer. It sets the chip's drive current, leakage, and reliability floor.
articles.excerptZh: 前段工艺（FEOL）在硅里建成晶体管本身——隔离、栅堆叠、结、源漏，第一次金属层之前的全部。它决定芯片的驱动电流、漏电与可靠性下限。

articles.titleEn: FOUP: Wafer Carrier and Microenvironment
articles.titleZh: FOUP：晶圆转运载具与受控微环境
articles.excerptEn: A FOUP encloses wafers between compatible process tools and can reduce exposure; door opening, materials, and storage conditions still shape contamination risk.
articles.excerptZh: FOUP 在兼容机台之间封闭转运晶圆并降低部分暴露；开门、材料和存放条件仍影响沾污风险。

articles.titleEn: Guide to Gate Interconnect: Physics, Process Integration, and Nanoscale Evolution
articles.titleZh: 栅极互连指南：物理原理、工艺集成与纳米级演进
articles.excerptEn: In modern semiconductor manufacturing, the gate interconnect represents the critical physical and electrical bridge between the active transistor switching element and the upper…
articles.excerptZh: 在现代半导体制造中，栅极互连代表了有源晶体管开关元件与上层金属化布线层之间的关键物理及电气桥梁。该接口负责向栅极提供电压激励，通过调节晶体管沟道的静电势来切换器件的导通与关断状态。

articles.titleEn: Gate Oxidation: Physical Principles, Mechanisms, and Process Evolution
articles.titleZh: 栅氧化：物理原理、机制与工艺演进
articles.excerptEn: Gate oxidation is the foundational process of forming a highly reliable insulating dielectric layer on a semiconductor substrate.
articles.excerptZh: 栅极氧化是半导体衬底上形成高可靠性绝缘介电层的奠基工艺。该工艺所产生的栅极氧化层（GOX）在金属-氧化物-半导体场效应晶体管（MOSFET）中充当栅电极与半导体沟道之间的关键阻挡层。

articles.titleEn: Gate Oxidation (GOX): Physical Principles, Mechanisms, and Process Evolution in Semiconductor Manufacturing
articles.titleZh: 栅氧化层制备：半导体制造中的物理原理、机制与工艺演进
articles.excerptEn: Gate oxidation (GOX) is the thermal process of growing a thin, high-quality silicon dioxide (SiO₂) layer on a silicon substrate to serve as the gate dielectric in a…
articles.excerptZh: 栅极氧化（GOX）是在硅衬底上通过热工艺生长一层薄且高质量的二氧化硅（SiO₂）层，用作金属-氧化物-半导体场效应晶体管（MOSFET）中的栅极介质。

articles.titleEn: Hafnium Dioxide in Semiconductor Manufacturing: Physics, Integration, and Advanced Node Scaling
articles.titleZh: 半导体制造中的二氧化铪：物理特性、集成与先进节点微缩
articles.excerptEn: HfO₂ helps a CMOS gate retain capacitance with more physical insulation. Learn how the interface, metal gate and anneal shape its actual electrical behavior.
articles.excerptZh: HfO₂ 有助于栅极在保留电容的同时增加物理绝缘间隔；硅侧界面、金属栅和退火共同决定其真实电学效果。

articles.titleEn: Hard Mask: How Pattern Transfer Works
articles.titleZh: 先进半导体图形化中硬掩模工程的基本原理
articles.excerptEn: A hard mask carries a resist pattern into a later etch when resist alone would erode or distort. Follow a real SiO-mask sequence from deposition to removal.
articles.excerptZh: 硬掩模在光刻胶难以保持形状时承接图形并保护下方材料。沿真实 SiO 掩模流程区分沉积、开口、硅刻蚀与去除。

articles.titleEn: High Aspect Ratio: Etch Deep, Fill Void-Free
articles.titleZh: 高深宽比工艺：刻得深，还要填得满
articles.excerptEn: High aspect ratio processing links deep etch, surface coverage, and gap filling. Learn how transport, reaction, sidewall protection, and premature closure affect different stages—and why one favorable parameter cannot guarantee a sound result.
articles.excerptZh: 高深宽比工艺连接深刻蚀、表面覆盖与间隙填充。理解输运、反应、侧壁保护和过早封口如何影响不同阶段，以及为什么一个有利参数不能保证整体结果。

articles.titleEn: HKMG Integration: Why Metal-Gate-Last Is Not Always High-k-Last
articles.titleZh: HKMG：高-k 时序与金属栅后置
articles.excerptEn: Metal-gate-last does not determine when high-k is formed. Trace early GATE, intermediate source/drain processing and later RMG in the 28nm teaching Flow, then distinguish metal replacement from CMP.
articles.excerptZh: 金属栅后置不能决定 high-k 何时形成。沿 28nm 教学 Flow 追踪早期 GATE、中间源漏加工与后期 RMG，再区分金属替换和 CMP。

articles.titleEn: HKMG Explained: High-k Dielectrics, Metal Gates and EOT
articles.titleZh: HKMG 原理：高-k 介质、金属栅与 EOT
articles.excerptEn: Separate dielectric capacitance, polysilicon depletion and effective work function.
articles.excerptZh: 区分介质电容、多晶硅耗尽与有效功函数。

articles.titleEn: Hydrofluoric Acid (HF): Selectivity Limits
articles.titleZh: 氢氟酸刻蚀：对氧化硅的选择性及适用边界
articles.excerptEn: HF can remove silicon dioxide faster than silicon in selected oxide cleans. Oxidizers and neighboring films change that selectivity; check the full stack.
articles.excerptZh: 在部分清洗中，HF 可比晶体硅更快去除二氧化硅；氧化剂及邻近材料会改变选择性，须按完整膜栈核验。

articles.titleEn: Interlayer Dielectric (ILD) in Semiconductor Manufacturing: Physical Principles, Integration Logic, and Advanced Node Evolution
articles.titleZh: 半导体制造中的层间介质（ILD）：物理原理、集成逻辑与先进节点演进
articles.excerptEn: The interlayer dielectric (ILD) is one of the most foundational thin films in integrated circuit manufacturing.
articles.excerptZh: 层间介质（ILD）是集成电路制造中最基础的薄膜之一。其核心作用是在导电结构之间沉积绝缘层——无论是前段工艺（FEOL）中栅极电极与源/漏接触之间的绝缘，还是后段工艺（BEOL）中金属互连层级之间的绝缘——以提供电气隔离…

articles.titleEn: Deep Dive into In-Situ Steam Generation (ISSG) in Semiconductor Processing: Physics, Kinetics, and Integration
articles.titleZh: 半导体工艺中原位蒸汽生成（ISSG）的深度解析：物理学、动力学与集成
articles.excerptEn: In modern complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor (CMOS) fabrication, the synthesis of high-quality silicon dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) thin films with precise atomic-level control…
articles.excerptZh: 简介 在现代互补金属氧化物半导体（CMOS）制造中，具有精确原子级控制的高质量二氧化硅（$\text{SiO}_2$）薄膜的合成是器件性能的基石。

articles.titleEn: Physics and Integration of Inductively Coupled Plasma in Advanced Semiconductor Manufacturing
articles.titleZh: 先进半导体制造中电感耦合等离子体（ICP）的物理机制与集成
articles.excerptEn: Inductively coupled plasma (ICP) represents a fundamental technological pillar in modern semiconductor fabrication, enabling precise pattern transfer and material surface…
articles.excerptZh: 简介 感应耦合等离子体（ICP）是现代半导体制造中的核心技术支柱，能够实现精确的图形转移和材料表面改性。随着器件几何尺寸的缩小和结构复杂性的提升，对方向性好、低损伤刻蚀以及可控沉积的需求，促使高密度等离子体源得到了广泛…

articles.titleEn: Semiconductor Interfaces: Physical Principles, Charge Mechanisms, and Integration Challenges in Advanced CMOS
articles.titleZh: 半导体界面：先进CMOS中的物理原理、电荷机制与集成挑战
articles.excerptEn: In semiconductor manufacturing, an interface is the atomically thin boundary region where two dissimilar materials meet — most famously the silicon/silicon dioxide (Si/SiO₂)…
articles.excerptZh: 在半导体制造中，界面是两种不同材料相遇的原子级薄边界区域——最著名的是支撑互补金属氧化物半导体（CMOS）技术的硅/二氧化硅（Si/SiO₂）界面。

articles.titleEn: Understanding Interlayer Dielectric (ILD) in Advanced Semiconductor Manufacturing
articles.titleZh: 理解先进半导体制造中的层间介质 (ILD)
articles.excerptEn: In modern ultra-large-scale integration (ULSI) devices, the performance of integrated circuits is no longer determined solely by active transistor switching speeds.
articles.excerptZh: 简介 在现代超大规模集成（ULSI）器件中，集成电路的性能已不再仅仅由晶体管的有源开关速度决定。相反，用于在数百万个逻辑门之间传输电信号的后段工艺（BEOL）互连系统已成为主要性能瓶颈。

articles.titleEn: Ion Channeling in Semiconductor Manufacturing: Physics, Control, and Device Impact
articles.titleZh: 半导体制造中的离子沟道效应：物理机制、控制与器件影响
articles.excerptEn: Ion channeling is a fundamental physical phenomenon in semiconductor manufacturing where energetic ions travel anomalously long distances through open spaces, or "channels,"…
articles.excerptZh: 简介 离子沟道效应是半导体制造中的一种基本物理现象，即高能离子在单晶晶格的开放空间（即“沟道”）中穿行时会发生异常长距离的穿透。在离子注入工艺中，掺杂离子被加速注入半导体衬底以调节其电导率。

articles.titleEn: Ion Implantation: Stopping, Channeling, Dose and Activation
articles.titleZh: 离子注入：阻止、沟道效应、剂量与激活
articles.excerptEn: Follow ions from beam delivery to retained and active profiles, and check where masking, channeling and later thermal processing change the result.
articles.excerptZh: 沿束流输送、保留分布到电活性分布，检查掩模、沟道效应及后续热过程如何改变结果。

articles.titleEn: Laser Spike Anneal: Physical Principles, Process Integration, and Evolution in Semiconductor Manufacturing
articles.titleZh: 激光尖峰退火：物理原理、工艺集成与半导体制造中的演变
articles.excerptEn: Laser Spike Anneal (LSA) represents a critical thermal processing technology in advanced semiconductor manufacturing, engineered to deliver ultra-high temperatures to the surface…
articles.excerptZh: 激光尖峰退火（LSA）是先进半导体制造中的一项关键热处理技术，旨在将极高温度在极短时间内施加于硅片表面。随着器件尺寸不断缩小，半导体行业面临着一个根本性的热力学矛盾：注入硅晶格的掺杂剂必须在高温下进行电激活，但同样的高…

articles.titleEn: Low Energy Contact (LEC) in Semiconductor Manufacturing: Physics, Process Principles, and Advanced Node Evolution
articles.titleZh: 低能量接触（Low Energy Contact，LEC）在半导体制造中的应用：物理学、工艺原理及先进节点演进
articles.excerptEn: As CMOS technology scales deeper into the nanometer regime, the resistance associated with the interface between metal interconnects and semiconductor source/drain regions—known…
articles.excerptZh: 随着CMOS技术持续微缩进入纳米尺度，金属互连与半导体源/漏区界面相关的电阻——即接触电阻——已成为限制晶体管性能的最主要寄生元件之一。

articles.titleEn: Lightly Doped Drain Extension: Principles, Physics, and Process Integration
articles.titleZh: 轻掺杂漏极扩展区：原理、物理与工艺集成
articles.excerptEn: As semiconductor device geometries have become smaller, short-channel effects have become a critical challenge in metal-oxide-semiconductor field-effect transistor (MOSFET)…
articles.excerptZh: 简介 随着半导体器件几何尺寸的不断缩小，短沟道效应已成为金属氧化物半导体场效应晶体管（MOSFET）微缩过程中的关键挑战。

articles.titleEn: Lightly Doped Drain (LDD): Physical Principles, Device Integration, and Technology Evolution
articles.titleZh: 轻掺杂漏极 (LDD)：物理原理、器件集成与技术演进
articles.excerptEn: An LDD extension spreads the drain-side electric field but adds series resistance. A 40nm NMOS photo-and-implant pair shows where it enters one flow.
articles.excerptZh: LDD 延伸区可分散漏侧电场，也带来串联电阻。40nm NMOS 的光刻与注入两步展示它在一个流程中的位置。

articles.titleEn: Engineering the Interfacial Bridge: Principles, Mechanisms, and Integration of Liner Layers in Advanced Semiconductor Manufacturing
articles.titleZh: 界面桥接工程：先进半导体制造中衬垫层的原理、机制与集成
articles.excerptEn: In the intricate architecture of modern integrated circuits, feature dimensions have scaled deep into the nanometer regime.
articles.excerptZh: 在现代集成电路错综复杂的架构中，特征尺寸已深缩至纳米量级。随着这些特征尺寸的压缩，不同材料之间的界面（特别是金属与电介质之间的界面）对器件的整体性能、可靠性和良率产生了主导性影响。

articles.titleEn: Understanding Litho-Etch-Litho-Etch (LELE): Physical Principles, Process Integration, and Advanced Node Evolution
articles.titleZh: 理解光刻-刻蚀-光刻-刻蚀（LELE）：物理原理、工艺集成与先进制程演进
articles.excerptEn: In the continuous pursuit of scaling down silicon integrated circuit (IC) features, semiconductor manufacturing eventually encountered the fundamental physical boundaries of…
articles.excerptZh: 简介 在持续追求缩小硅集成电路 (IC) 特征尺寸的过程中，半导体制造业最终遇到了光学分辨率的基本物理边界。根据瑞利分辨率准则，最小可分辨特征尺寸与曝光波长成正比，与投影光学系统的数值孔径 (NA) 成反比。

articles.titleEn: Deep Dive into Local Via (V0) Integration: Principles, Physics, and Advanced Node Challenges
articles.titleZh: 深入解析局部通孔（V0）集成：物理原理、工艺机制与先进制程挑战
articles.excerptEn: In modern integrated circuits, scaling transistor density requires severe reductions in device geometry and interconnect dimensions.

articles.titleEn: Advanced Semiconductor Manufacturing: Physics and Principles of Middle of Line (MOL) Integration
articles.titleZh: 先进半导体制造：中段工艺（MOL）集成的物理与原理

articles.titleEn: Engineering the Narrow Gate Region: Physics, Process Integration, and Advanced Node Scaling

articles.excerptEn: In complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor (CMOS) device scaling, shrinking gate dimensions is essential for driving density and performance improvements.
articles.excerptZh: 在互补金属氧化物半导体 (CMOS) 器件微缩过程中，缩小栅极尺寸对于提升集成密度和器件性能至关重要。“窄栅区域 (NRG)”是指晶体管中高度微缩的空间腔体及已完成的栅电极堆叠结构，其物理栅长被尽可能缩小。

articles.titleEn: Fundamental Principles of Nickel Silicide in Advanced Semiconductor Contact Engineering
articles.titleZh: 先进半导体接触工程中硅化镍的基本原理

articles.titleEn: Fundamental Principles of Nitrogen-Doped Carbide in Advanced Semiconductor Manufacturing
articles.titleZh: 先进半导体制造中氮掺杂碳化物的基本原理

articles.excerptZh: 在不断追求尺寸微缩和器件性能提升的过程中，半导体工业高度依赖于新型薄膜材料的工程化应用。氮掺杂碳化物（NDC）作为现代集成工艺的基石之一，已经崭露头角。

articles.titleZh: 揭秘半导体制造中的过抛光：机制、挑战与先进节点集成

articles.excerptZh: 在现代半导体制造中，实现硅片表面的全局平坦化是高分辨率光刻和多层互连集成的基本前提。这种空间均匀性主要通过化学机械平坦化（CMP）来实现，该工艺同时利用化学作用和机械磨削来去除多余材料。

articles.titleEn: Thermal Oxidation in Semiconductor Manufacturing: Physical Principles, Mechanisms, and Process Integration
articles.titleZh: 半导体制造中的热氧化工艺：物理原理、机理与工艺集成
articles.excerptEn: Thermal oxidation is one of the most foundational unit processes in semiconductor manufacturing, involving the controlled reaction of a silicon substrate with an oxidizing…
articles.excerptZh: 热氧化是半导体制造中最基础的工艺步骤之一，涉及硅衬底与氧化气氛（通常是分子氧O₂或水蒸气H₂O）在高温下的受控反应，以形成二氧化硅SiO₂。

articles.titleEn: Fundamentals of Oxide Densification in Advanced Semiconductor Manufacturing: Mechanisms, Kinetics, and Process Integration
articles.titleZh: 先进半导体制造中氧化物致密化的基础：机理、动力学与工艺集成

articles.excerptZh: 在现代半导体制造中，介质膜的质量直接决定了集成电路的电绝缘性、可靠性和性能。在所使用的各种介质中，二氧化硅和高-k金属氧化物无处不在，常用作栅极介质、隔离阻挡层和结构层。

articles.titleEn: Oxide Notch Etch in Semiconductor Manufacturing: Principles, Mechanisms, and Integration

articles.excerptZh: 氧化物缺口刻蚀在部分三维晶体管流程中选择性回缩氧化物。鳍暴露几何可能影响栅控与电流；现有 7nm 学习落点是流程总览，并非已命名的缺口步骤。

articles.titleEn: PAI: Reading Implant Context in a 40nm Flow

articles.excerptZh: PAI 可在掺杂注入前减弱晶体沟道效应；再生长、激活与残余缺陷须分别核验。所链接的 40nm 流程未标明 PAI。

articles.titleEn: Fundamental Principles of Passivation in Semiconductor Manufacturing: Physics, Mechanisms, and Integration
articles.titleZh: 半导体制造中钝化的基本原理：物理机制与集成工艺

articles.excerptZh: 钝化是半导体制造中的一项基本工艺。其核心是指在半导体表面或界面上有意形成保护层或化学状态，以抑制不利的物理、化学或电学相互作用。

articles.titleEn: Fundamental Principles of Stress Memorization Techniques and Pattern Stress Engineering in Advanced CMOS Integration
articles.titleZh: 先进CMOS集成中应力记忆技术与图形应力工程的基本原理

articles.excerptZh: 在先进半导体制造中，为了维持硅基集成电路的性能微缩轨迹，需要超越单纯的尺寸缩减，对材料的物理特性进行工程化控制。

articles.titleEn: PECVD: Plasma Chemistry and Film Growth
articles.titleZh: PECVD：等离子体化学与薄膜生长
articles.excerptEn: PECVD uses plasma-generated species to grow films; ICP-PECVD is one source design. Thermal budget, coverage, film quality and damage depend on chemistry and reactor conditions.
articles.excerptZh: PECVD 利用等离子体活性物种成膜；ICP-PECVD 是其中一种等离子体源设计。热预算、覆盖、膜质和损伤取决于化学与反应器条件。

articles.titleEn: Plasma Enhanced Oxide (PEOX): Fundamental Principles, Mechanisms, and Integration in Advanced Semiconductor Manufacturing
articles.titleZh: 等离子体增强氧化层（PEOX）：先进半导体制造中的基本原理、机理与集成

articles.titleEn: A Comprehensive Guide to Phosphosilicate Glass (PSG) in Semiconductor Manufacturing
articles.titleZh: 半导体制造中磷硅玻璃（PSG）综合指南
articles.excerptEn: PSG is phosphorus-containing oxide glass. Understand mobile-ion trapping, reflow and moisture risks, then use a real dielectric-to-contact sequence as a comparison rather than a PSG demonstration.
articles.excerptZh: PSG 是含磷氧化物玻璃。理解移动离子捕获、回流与吸湿风险，再用真实介质到接触的顺序作对照；该教学流程不演示 PSG。

articles.titleEn: Photolithography in a 40nm Process Flow
articles.titleZh: 40nm 工艺流程中的光刻与图形转移

articles.excerptZh: 光刻通过曝光和显影形成胶图形，以引导后续图形转移；步骤次数随芯片流程变化。

articles.titleEn: Photoresist in Semiconductor Manufacturing: Principles, Physics, and Process Evolution
articles.titleZh: 半导体制造中的光刻胶：原理、物理学与工艺演进
articles.excerptEn: Photoresist (PR) is a light-sensitive polymeric material that forms the foundation of pattern definition in modern semiconductor manufacturing.
articles.excerptZh: 简介 光刻胶（PR）是一种感光聚合物材料，构成了现代半导体制造中图形定义的基础。它是图形转移的主要介质，在干法刻蚀或离子注入等关键下游工艺步骤中充当临时牺牲掩模。

articles.titleEn: Technical Principles of Photoresist Removal in Advanced Semiconductor Manufacturing: Mechanisms, Challenges, and Node Evolution
articles.titleZh: 先进半导体制造中光刻胶去除的技术原理：机制、挑战与节点演进

articles.titleEn: Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD): Methods
articles.titleZh: 物理气相沉积（PVD）：蒸发、溅射及适用边界
articles.excerptEn: PVD transfers material from a source to a wafer by evaporation or sputtering. The final film depends on transport, chemistry and surface conditions.
articles.excerptZh: PVD 通过蒸发或溅射把材料从源送到晶圆；最终薄膜取决于输送、化学与表面条件。

articles.titleEn: Plasma Enhanced Chemical Vapor Deposition (PECVD): Physics, Mechanisms, and Integration in Advanced Manufacturing

articles.titleEn: Plasma Enhanced Oxide (PEOX): Principles, Chemical Mechanisms, and Advanced Node Integration

articles.titleEn: Pre-Metal Dielectric (PMD): Physics, Process Integration, and Evolution Across Advanced Semiconductor Nodes
articles.titleZh: 前金属介质（PMD）：物理学、工艺集成及在先进半导体节点中的演进
articles.excerptEn: In the architecture of a modern integrated circuit, the transition from front-end-of-line (FEOL) transistor fabrication to back-end-of-line (BEOL) interconnect metallization…
articles.excerptZh: 在现代集成电路架构中，从前段工艺（FEOL）晶体管制造过渡到后段工艺（BEOL）互连金属化，需要一个关键的绝缘层，该层将器件级结构与第一金属互连层进行电学隔离。该层被称为预金属介质层（PMD）。

articles.titleEn: Mastering PMOS Lightly Doped Drain: Device Physics, Process Integration, and Nanoscale Evolution
articles.titleZh: 掌握 PMOS 轻掺杂漏极（PLDD）：器件物理、工艺集成与纳米级演进

articles.excerptZh: PMOS 轻掺杂延伸区可降低局部电场，但要权衡电阻。现有 40nm 流程标注的是 NMOS LDD，并非 PMOS LDD 步骤。

articles.titleEn: Retrograde Well Process: Principles, Physics, and Advanced Semiconductor Integration

articles.excerptZh: 简介 在现代互补金属氧化物半导体（CMOS）微缩中，保持静电控制并同时最小化寄生电阻是器件物理学家和工艺工程师面临的最关键挑战之一。

articles.titleEn: Spin-On Dielectric (SOD) in Semiconductor Manufacturing: Principles, Physics, and Process Integration
articles.titleZh: 半导体制造中的旋涂电介质 (SOD)：原理、物理机制与工艺集成
articles.excerptEn: In the continuous pursuit of higher integration density in semiconductor manufacturing, the reliable isolation of densely packed electrical components is paramount.
articles.excerptZh: 简介 在半导体制造对更高集成密度的不断追求中，高密度电子元件的可靠隔离至关重要。良好的电气隔离至关重要，这包括具备低介电常数等特性，以确保线间电容保持在较低水平 T1。

articles.titleEn: Spin On Glass (SOG): Physical Principles, Curing Mechanisms, and Process Integration
articles.titleZh: 旋涂玻璃 (SOG)：物理原理、固化机制与工艺集成

articles.excerptZh: 旋涂玻璃在固化前减轻表面起伏，并转化为类氧化物介质。分清 SOG、SOC 与 FCVD，再通过真实 FCVD 隔离路线对照衬垫、填充与 CMP 的不同职责。

articles.titleEn: Fundamentals of Stress Memorization Technique (SMT) in Advanced Silicon Manufacturing
articles.titleZh: 高级硅制造中应力记忆技术（SMT）的基本原理

articles.titleEn: Understanding Semiconductor Substrates: Physics, Process Integration, and Advanced Node Evolution
articles.titleZh: 理解半导体衬底：物理原理、工艺集成与先进节点演进
articles.excerptEn: In semiconductor manufacturing, the term "substrate" refers to any underlying material or materials upon which a device, a circuit, or a thin film can be formed.
articles.excerptZh: 在半导体制造中，术语“衬底”指代可在其上形成器件、电路或薄膜的任何底层材料或多层材料结构。在最基本的物理层面上，衬底是每个集成电路的物理与电气基础——它是构建晶体管、金属互连和无源元件的晶体平台。

articles.titleEn: Fundamental Principles of Surface Cleaning in Advanced Semiconductor Manufacturing: Physical Mechanisms, Chemical Kinetics, and Node Evolution
articles.titleZh: 先进半导体制造中表面清洗的基本原理：物理机制、化学动力学与节点演进
articles.excerptEn: Surface cleaning prepares a specified surface for the next process. The linked cleaning stations give context; contamination and downstream benefit require measurement.
articles.excerptZh: 表面清洗为下一道工序准备指定表面。所链接清洗工位提供背景；污染与后续收益须量测。

articles.titleEn: Tantalum Nitride (TaN) in Semiconductor Manufacturing: Physics, Processes, and Integration
articles.titleZh: 半导体制造中的氮化钽 (TaN)：物理特性、工艺与应用
articles.excerptEn: TaN can separate copper from surrounding dielectrics, but barrier continuity and film structure matter. Learn its M1 role and the distinct gate-stack use.
articles.excerptZh: TaN 可在铜与周围介质之间形成阻挡边界，但连续性和薄膜结构决定效果。了解其 M1 职责及不同的栅叠层用途。

articles.titleEn: Fundamentals of Tapered Profile Etch in Semiconductor Fabrication: Principles, Mechanisms, and Integration
articles.titleZh: 半导体制造中锥形轮廓刻蚀的基础：原理、机制与集成
articles.excerptEn: Tapered profile etch, often referred to as slope etch or tapered etch, is a specialized dry etching technique designed to fabricate features with controlled, non-vertical…
articles.excerptZh: 锥形轮廓刻蚀（Tapered profile etch），通常被称为斜坡刻蚀或锥形刻蚀，是一种专门的干法刻蚀技术，旨在制造具有可控、非垂直侧壁角度的特征结构。

articles.titleEn: Process Temperature and Thermal Budget
articles.titleZh: 工艺温度与热预算：半导体制造中的权衡
articles.excerptEn: Temperature affects diffusion, reaction rates, stress, and process control in different ways. Thermal budget depends on both time and materials already in the stack.
articles.excerptZh: 温度以不同方式影响扩散、反应速率、应力和工艺控制；热预算同时取决于时间与叠层材料。

articles.titleEn: TEOS in Chipmaking: Oxide Precursor and Limits
articles.titleZh: TEOS 是什么：氧化硅前驱体及成膜边界
articles.excerptEn: TEOS is a liquid silicon precursor used in some oxide CVD routes. Film coverage and composition depend on oxidants, activation and geometry.
articles.excerptZh: TEOS 是部分氧化硅 CVD 路线使用的液体含硅前驱体；覆盖和组成取决于氧化剂、活化方式与几何结构。

articles.titleEn: TMAH: The Metal-Free Developer and Si Etchant
articles.titleZh: TMAH 是什么：无金属离子的显影液与硅刻蚀剂
articles.excerptEn: Tetramethylammonium hydroxide (TMAH) is a metal-cation-free quaternary base: positive-resist developer, anisotropic silicon etchant, and alkaline engine of post-CMP cleans — a chemical platform built on high pH without metallic contamination.
articles.excerptZh: 氢氧化四甲铵（TMAH）是无金属阳离子的季铵强碱：光刻胶显影液、单晶硅各向异性刻蚀剂、CMP 后清洗的碱性组分——一个围绕高 pH 与零金属污染建立的化学平台。

articles.titleEn: Thermal Diffusion in Semiconductor Manufacturing: Principles, Physics, and Process Evolution
articles.titleZh: 半导体制造中的热扩散：原理、物理机制与工艺演进
articles.excerptEn: In the realm of semiconductor manufacturing, thermal diffusion is a fundamental process that governs the movement of atoms, ions, and point defects within a solid crystal lattice…
articles.excerptZh: 在半导体制造领域，热扩散是一种基础工艺，用于控制原子、离子和点缺陷在高温影响下的固态晶格内移动。从历史上看，该工艺是将掺杂原子引入硅衬底以形成 p-n 结的主要方法，从而确定分立器件和集成电路的电气特性。

articles.titleEn: Understanding Thickness in Semiconductor Manufacturing: Physical Principles, Metrology, and Node Evolution
articles.titleZh: 半导体制造中的厚度理解：物理原理、计量学与节点演进
articles.excerptEn: In semiconductor manufacturing, thickness refers to the vertical dimension of a deposited or grown film layer—whether it is a gate dielectric, a metal interconnect, a spacer, or…
articles.excerptZh: 在半导体制造中，厚度指的是沉积或生长的薄膜层——无论是栅介质、金属互连、侧墙还是外延沟道——垂直于晶圆表面测量的垂直尺寸。

articles.titleEn: Engineering the Thin Film Resistor: Physical Principles, BEOL Integration, and Advanced Node Evolution
articles.titleZh: 薄膜电阻器的工程设计：物理原理、BEOL集成与先进节点演进
articles.excerptEn: In the design of modern integrated circuits (ICs), passive components are just as critical to overall system performance as active transistors.
articles.excerptZh: 在现代集成电路（IC）设计中，无源元件与有源晶体管对系统整体性能同样重要。在这些无源元件中，薄膜电阻（TFR）是模拟、混合信号、射频（RF）和高压应用的基础构建模块。

articles.titleEn: Threshold Voltage Implant: Physics, Mechanisms, and Process Evolution in Semiconductor Manufacturing

articles.excerptZh: 在现代集成电路制造中，精确控制晶体管的开关特性对于芯片的整体性能、功耗和可靠性至关重要。这种控制的核心在于阈值电压注入（Threshold Voltage…

articles.titleEn: Threshold Voltage (Vth): Definition and Control
articles.titleZh: 阈值电压（Vth）：晶体管靠什么设定开启门槛
articles.excerptEn: Threshold voltage (Vth) is the gate voltage where a transistor turns on — the speed-versus-leakage knob. Fabs set it with three levers: Vt-adjust implants, high-k gate stacks, and work-function metals.
articles.excerptZh: 阈值电压（Vth）是晶体管开启的栅压——速度与漏电的总旋钮。产线用三根杠杆设定它：阈值调整注入、高 k 栅堆叠与功函数金属。

articles.titleEn: Titanium Nitride (TiN): Physical Principles, Process Integration, and Advanced Semiconductor Applications
articles.titleZh: 氮化钛 (TiN)：物理原理、工艺集成与先进半导体应用
articles.excerptEn: Titanium nitride (TiN) is a highly versatile transition metal nitride that has become a cornerstone material in modern semiconductor manufacturing.
articles.excerptZh: 氮化钛 (TiN) 是一种用途极其广泛的过渡金属氮化物，已成为现代半导体制造中的基石材料。TiN 在本体状态下以其独特的金色光泽而闻名，属于一类难熔化合物，具有卓越的机械硬度、高熔点以及出色的热稳定性和化学稳定性。

articles.titleEn: Tungsten in Semiconductor Contacts
articles.titleZh: 先进半导体制造中的钨金属化：材料物理、沉积机制与集成挑战
articles.excerptEn: Why is tungsten used in semiconductor contacts? Follow the interface, fill and planarization that form an isolated conductive plug.
articles.excerptZh: 钨如何形成半导体接触插塞？沿界面、填充与平坦化理解隔离的导电通路。

articles.titleEn: Understanding Ultra Low-K Dielectrics: Physics, Integration, and Advanced Node Challenges
articles.titleZh: 理解超低介电常数（Ultra Low-K）电介质：物理特性、集成与先进工艺节点挑战
articles.excerptEn: In modern microelectronics, the relentless scaling of integrated circuits has driven active device density and performance demands to unprecedented levels.
articles.excerptZh: 在现代微电子技术中，集成电路的持续微缩将器件密度与性能需求推向了前所未有的高度。然而，随着晶体管开关速度的提升，集成电路的整体性能日益受到后段工艺（BEOL）互连系统的制约。

articles.titleEn: Undoped Silicate Glass (USG) in Semiconductor Manufacturing: Principles, Mechanical Reliability, and Process Integration
articles.titleZh: 半导体制造中的未掺杂硅酸盐玻璃（USG）：原理、机械可靠性与工艺集成
articles.excerptEn: USG names an undoped oxide glass, not a purity or reliability guarantee. Separate deposition, liner, gap fill and CMP, then locate their different duties in a real 14nm STI sequence.
articles.excerptZh: USG 是未掺杂氧化物玻璃的名称，不是纯净或可靠性保证。分开沉积、衬垫、间隙填充与 CMP，再在真实 14nm STI 顺序中定位各自职责。

articles.titleEn: Uniformity in Semiconductor Manufacturing: Physical Principles, Process Control, and Advanced Node Challenges
articles.titleZh: 半导体制造中的均匀性：物理原理、工艺控制与先进节点挑战
articles.excerptEn: Uniformity is the measure of how consistently a process outcome — whether a film thickness, a critical dimension (CD), an etch depth, or a dopant concentration — is maintained…
articles.excerptZh: 均匀性衡量的是工艺结果（无论是薄膜厚度、关键尺寸 (CD)、刻蚀深度还是掺杂浓度）在晶圆内、晶圆间以及批次间的一致性。

articles.titleEn: Vertical Interconnect Access (Via): Physical Principles, Integration Logic, and Advanced Node Evolution
articles.titleZh: 垂直互连通路（Via）：物理原理、集成逻辑与先进节点演进
articles.excerptEn: A via connects two wiring levels. Follow the actual Via 1 photo and dielectric etch steps, then compare the earlier contact examples without confusing the two.
articles.excerptZh: 通孔连接不同布线层。沿真实 Via 1 光刻与介质刻蚀步骤学习，再与更早的接触示例对照，避免把两者混同。

articles.titleEn: Mastering Void-Free Fill in Advanced Semiconductor Manufacturing: Physical Principles, Process Engineering, and Node Evolution
articles.titleZh: 精通先进制程半导体制造中的无孔隙填充：物理原理、工艺工程与制程节点演进
articles.excerptEn: In modern ultra-large-scale integration (ULSI) complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor (CMOS) fabrication, the ability to seamlessly deposit materials into high-aspect-ratio…
articles.excerptZh: 简介 在现代超大规模集成（ULSI）互补金属氧化物半导体（CMOS）制造中，将材料无缝填充至高深宽比（HAR）特征结构中的能力是器件性能与可靠性的基石。

articles.titleEn: Wet Clean in Semiconductor Manufacturing: Physics, Mechanisms, and Integration
articles.titleZh: 半导体制造中的湿法清洗：物理、机制与集成
articles.excerptEn: Wet clean is a foundational process in semiconductor manufacturing, designed to remove particulate, metallic, organic, and native oxide contamination from wafer surfaces.
articles.excerptZh: 湿法清洗是半导体制造中的基础工艺，旨在去除晶圆表面的颗粒、金属、有机物和自然氧化层污染。在集成电路制造的高灵敏度环境中，即便是原子级的杂质或极微小的分子污染物，也可能严重降低器件性能、改变电学特性并损害整体良率。

articles.titleEn: Wet Etching: Selectivity and Anisotropy
articles.titleZh: 湿法刻蚀：选择比、侧蚀与晶向各向异性
articles.excerptEn: Wet etching removes material in liquid; selectivity and undercut depend on chemistry and stack, while crystalline silicon can etch anisotropically.
articles.excerptZh: 湿法刻蚀在液体中去除材料；选择比和侧蚀取决于化学体系与膜栈，单晶硅还可能表现晶向各向异性。

articles.titleEn: The Physics, Integration, and Evolution of Work Function in Advanced Semiconductor Manufacturing
articles.titleZh: 先进半导体制造中功函数的物理机制、集成与演进
articles.excerptEn: In the realm of advanced semiconductor manufacturing, the concept of work function (WF) is a cornerstone of transistor design and performance scaling.
articles.excerptZh: 在先进半导体制造领域，功函数（Work Function, WF）的概念是晶体管设计和性能微缩的基石。从历史上看，早期的金属氧化物半导体场效应晶体管（MOSFET）依靠重掺杂多晶硅作为栅电极，通过掺杂浓度调节费米能级以…

articles.primaryKeyword: Why bond before thinning a backside-illuminated sensor?
articles.titleEn: Why bond before thinning a backside-illuminated sensor?
articles.titleZh: 背照式传感器为什么先键合，再减薄？
articles.excerptEn: Backside illumination involves more than turning a device drawing upside down. Sensor silicon must be removed to a state suitable for later electrical and optical integration, while the progressively thinner structure still has to survive processing and handling. Bonding first supplies support for that removal.
articles.excerptZh: 让光从传感器背面进入，并不只是把器件在图上翻过来。背面硅需要被去除到适合后续器件与光学集成的状态，而越来越薄的传感器结构还必须承受加工和搬运。键合首先解决的就是后续材料去除所需的支撑问题。

articles.titleEn: Why Replacement Metal Gate Starts with a Dummy Gate
articles.titleZh: 替换金属栅为什么先做占位栅？
articles.excerptEn: Understand how a dummy gate preserves geometry and what must remain intact when the final metal gate replaces it.
articles.excerptZh: 理解占位栅怎样保存几何，以及替换为最终金属栅时哪些边界必须保留。

articles.titleEn: Why STI Can Be Recessed After Filling and CMP
articles.titleZh: STI 已填充并平坦化，为什么还可能需要回蚀？
articles.excerptEn: See why STI filling, CMP and later recess can serve different geometric goals in a device integration sequence.
articles.excerptZh: 解释STI填充、CMP和后续回蚀为何服务于不同几何目标。
